turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have until then. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first; who decided that?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
You didn't answer me. The zero went in before anyone picked up a phone, and I want to know whose decision that was.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

A machine's guess, Hale, and that's still not who decided. The company that makes these detectors says in its own guide that they shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student, and I have it printed in my bag. What else do you have?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Fourteen of these tools were tested in 2023 and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable, and your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything. So I'll ask once more: is there anything besides a number, or am I going to the principal's office from here?
So I had to give him a zero.

"Had to." Your procedure says you speak to Owen first and call me before any mark goes in, and you did neither, so you decided first and asked questions later. Withdraw the zero and apologize to my son, or I'm walking straight to the principal.
I hope you understand my position.
"Your position." Your position is a number from a machine and a zero entered before anyone called me. Is there a document, Hale, or is that all of it?
